Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma
Bench: Subhash Chandra Sharma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 80
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 12767 of 2022
Applicant :- Anil

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Prem Chandra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Supplementary affidavit is taken on record by the learned counsel for the applicant.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.

This anticipatory bail application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 308 of 2022, under sections 120-B, 323, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 473, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Shahganj, District Jaunpur.
Facts in brief are that the informant and Bipat were two brothers.
Bipat was unmarried and went away from home in the year 1995, as a result in revenue record he was entered as deceased.

After a lapse of time, the informant became successor of Bipat but present applicant got his name entered into revenue record fraudently by misrepresentating himself as a son of Bipat in the year 1995.

When this fact was challenged, an objection was also filed by co-accused Sunil Kumar the brother of Anil vs State Of U.P. on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8946262/
1 the present applicant which was also dismissed in the year 2017.
Then, name of Bipat was again brought on record and the informant was mutated on this place.
Later on, a civil suit was filed in the year 2022 in the name of mother Nirmala, the co-accused.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that he is innocent and has committed no offence.
It is also submitted that the applicant is Guard in Railway Department, therefore, he had no any concern with the present dispute but on account of slip his name was mutated in revenue records.
It is further submitted that co-accused Sunil Kumar has done the proceedings in his name though he is not interested at all.
Even the revision and civil suit was filed by co-accused Sunil Kumar on behalf of his mother Nirmala by Sunil Kumar.
Since investigation is going on and there is apprehension of imminent arrest against the applicant, so requested for anticipatory bail.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid.

On considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perusal of record, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and considering the nature of accusation and his antecedents, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case for the limited period considering the exception considered by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC Online SC 98.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC Online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In default of any of the conditions, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the applicant.
